name: Utawarerumono: Futari no Hakuoro
original_name: うたわれるもの 二人の白皇
source:
Continues from directly after the events at the end of Itsuwari no Kamen/Mask of Deception.

[spoiler]"...I leave Her Highness... in your hands."
"Nekone, live on... and find happiness."

With these final words, Oshtor's soul finally found peace... leaving Haku entrusted with his sister and the princess. For the sake of his friends, and to fulfill his promise, Haku casts aside the name he was given... and dons his fallen friend's mask, choosing to live on as Oshtor.

Armed with his wits and the power of Oshtor's name, Haku faces a battle more dire than any before. Nekone steels herself to support Haku through whatever comes, suppressing the pain of her dear brother's death. Their friends mourn the loss of two dear comrades: Haku, whom they believe dead, and Kuon, who left them for her homeland.[/spoiler]

It is here, on the cusp of a new conflict, where we return to this land. The flames of war are about to consume Ennakamuy... and soon, all of Yamato.

[From [url=http://atlus.com/uta/truth/home.html]Atlus[/url]]

The next game in the series, after [url=/v18717]Utawarerumono: Futari no Hakuoro[/url] and a prequel to [url=/v7721]Utawarerumono: Itsuwari no Kamen[/url], is a JRPG [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1962430/Monochrome_Mobius_Rights_and_Wrongs_Forgotten/]Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten[/url], available on PS5/PS4/PC.
translation:
紧接着《五割之假面/欺骗面具》结尾事件之后继续。

[spoiler]“……我把殿下……交给你了。”
“Nekone，活下去……找到幸福。”

随着这最后一句话，奥什托的灵魂终于找到了平静……把哈库托付给他的妹妹和公主。为了他的朋友，也为了履行他的诺言，白抛弃了他被赋予的名字……并戴上了他死去的朋友的面具，选择以奥什托的身份继续生活。

凭借自己的智慧和奥什托名字的力量，白面临着一场比以往更加可怕的战斗。Nekone坚强地支持白，无论发生什么，压制她亲爱的哥哥去世的痛苦。他们的朋友们哀悼失去了两位亲爱的战友：白，他们相信他已经死了，库翁，离开了他们回到了祖国。[/spoiler]正是在这里，在一场新冲突的风口浪尖上，我们回到了这片土地。战火即将吞噬Ennakamuy……很快，整个大和岛都会被吞噬。

[来自[url=http://atlus.com/uta/truth/home.html]Atlus[/url]]

该系列的下一款游戏是继[url=/v18717]Utawarerumono: Futari no Hakuoro[/url]和[url=/v7721]Utawarerumono: Itsuwari no Kamen[/url]的前传之后，是一款JRPG [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1962430/Monochrome_Mobius_Rights_and_Wrongs_Forgotten/]Monochrome Mobius: Right and Wrongs Forgotten[/url]，可在PS5/PS4/PC。
